chart_plan.constraints: Copy Main-computed percentages exactly. limits: The frozen packet is adequate for these data proposals; no additional factual-source request is needed. Preserve existing ledger count and limit 20.
MAX chooses useful chart count, forms and placement through the existing render/media owner; this proposal is not inspected media or final approval.
September first-print payroll context and November-release revised September values are distinct vintages; do not silently substitute either.
No current guidance or new probability inference. Keep computation-generation, data observation, release, writing and publication clocks distinct.
Public dates/times use ET. Preserve cutoff 2026-11-14T11:04:18.352247Z and both required notices. Keep source markers privately.

photo_plan.fallback: Use the original release card and admitted data charts if no lawful relevant photograph is found; do not invent a license or hold the supported review for an optional photograph.
photo_plan.freshness: Use new piece-specific bytes and existing SHA256/perceptual-hash checks. Never reuse Fed-building or Capitol photos.
photo_plan.lead_market: EURUSD internal binding; public EUR/USD spot or 6E futures named distinctly. A current TradingView snapshot must not appear as a November 6 event observation; event pieces keep release card first. Prefer the source-bound historical reaction figure for this retrospective.
photo_plan.rights: Inspect original asset page and exact creator, license, depicted date, attribution and reuse restrictions before use. A BLS text/data public-domain tag does not grant rights to a photo, logo or third-party asset.
photo_plan.subject: Authentic US employment context, such as workers or a workplace photographed by a federal agency, with a precise archive caption; never imply the image depicts the October survey or November release.

story_plan.thesis: Prepare the dated NFP retrospective around the frozen Strong condition being met, the distinct observed intraday co-movement, and the lesson that a separate one-event categorical comparison does not establish predictive skill. Preserve the exact event-resolution packet and existing previews. MAX authors all public prose.
